name: Aurora Weather
releaseNotes: Pauses background widget/location and alert retry work while Android reports no validated internet. The opt-in live widget location service now stops its foreground location listeners in airplane mode and resumes after a network-constrained widget job runs again, while alert/widget alarms use non-wakeup offline backstops instead of repeated wakeups.
description: Aurora Weather is a local weather app focused on clear current conditions, forecasts, rain awareness, widgets, and location-aware updates. It can follow the phone's current position, actively refresh widget weather after movement, cache recent results, and support practical daily/weather-alert workflows without requiring an account.
